text:
anya (eval): flagging a regression on mixed CJK+RTL translation suite. New model cicada-v1:2026-03 quantized q4a shows bracket mirroring and token joiner noise for zh+ar payloads. BLEU down ~3.7 vs fp16 baseline.
hiro (ml): concrete example? short is fine.
anya (eval): input: 
`[zh] 他說：『今天(2026年)我們要參觀博物館』 [ar] وقال: «سنسافر غدًا»`
fp16 output: `他 說 ： 『 今天 ( 2026 年 ) 我們 要 參觀 博物館 』 وقال: « سنسافر غدًا »`
q4a output: `他 說 ：  『 今天 ( 2026 年 ) 我們 要 參觀 博物館 』 وقال: « سنسافر غدًا »`
(sorry the middle shows a weird invisible/control char before the start of the single corner quote and Arabic guillemets mirror incorrectly)
sana (tokenizer): that middle block looks like an inserted joiner/control (ZWJ/U+200D or ZWNJ/U+200C) or a surrogate control mapped by postprocess. tokenizer itself doesn't output those by default.
omar (quant): I ran a quick log dump for the generate call. model=cicada-v1:2026-03 mode=q4a seq_len=128. Kernel chosen: `attn_q4a_fused_v2`. At step 37 right before emitting the opening corner single quote token id 61012, topk logits: q4a_topk_step37: [(61013,-0.95),(61012,-1.05),(60001,-1.23)] fp16_topk_step37: [(61012,-0.60),(61013,-1.3),(60001,-1.9)]
anya (eval): so fp16 prefers the quote token; q4a prefers a near token (61013) which maps to CONTROL_JOINER in our postproc mapping. That explains the inserted invis char.
hiro (ml): why would quantization flip probabilities like that only for mixed-orient runs? any locale-specific embedding differences?
omar (quant): hypothesis: the q4a scaled output head has slightly different calibration; for tokens with similar logits (within ~0.4) the softmax can flip preference. It correlates with attention head scaling we changed in latest kernel micro-optim.
sana (tokenizer): possible mitigation: in postprocess map CONTROL_JOINER->no-op for known punctuation contexts (before quotes/brackets) when locale indicates vertical/hybrid layout. Cheap patch.
infra-bot: @omar requested canary job: job id 0xbeef101 queued on dedicated/gpu-pool-2. ETA ~6m.
omar (quant): starting targeted bisect: runs q4a with small scale adjustments on output_layer and with/without head_bias_correction. Will post results.
anya (eval): added small metric: PUNCT_LOC_ACCURACY (percent punctuation correctly attached to preceding token). fp16=93.1% q4a=82.4% on mixed-zh-ar set. That's material for customers embedding multilingual docs.
hiro (ml): plan proposal: 1) pause q4a deployment for languages with mixed CJK+RTL routes, 2) quick postproc to strip CONTROL_JOINER before punctuation, 3) longer fix: retune output head scaling or add bias correction in quant kernel. objections?
sana (tokenizer): will PR postproc strip and add unit test with the example. also add detok audit to fail if ZWJ/ZWNJ appear unexpectedly between CJK glyph and punctuation.
omar (quant): bisect log quick take: head_bias_correction=true recovers ordering in 70% of sampled cases; lowering output_scale by 0.03 flips logits back to fp16 order in local run. patch candidate incoming.
deploy-bot: @hiro blocked rollout: cicada-v1:q4a on route /translate/mixed-zh-ar until cleared.
ops-bot: incident created: MIXED-ORIENT-PUNCT-2026, assigned to ml + quant.
anya (eval): I'll run the full mixed-zh-ar regression after PRs land. if postproc recovers BLEU to within 1.0 we can ship as interim.
hiro (ml): timeline: postproc hotfix in next 2h, quant tuning attempt in 8h. fallback to fp16 routing policy if unresolved by EOD.
sana (tokenizer): PR will include example pairs and CI detok checks. tagging @omar for test vectors.
omar (quant): will attach n-best dumps and per-token logit deltas to the bug. sample log snippet: `q4a_step37_logits: 61013:-0.95 61012:-1.05 60001:-1.23` vs `fp16_step37_logits: 61012:-0.60 61013:-1.30`.
hiro (ml): thanks. keep updates here. :raised_hands:
